description: The file defines the CustomFieldDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing custom fields related to employee data, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching custom fields, as well as managing their display and usage within the HR system.

classes.name: CustomFieldDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing CustomField entities, handling database transactions for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching custom fields within the HR system.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Creates or updates a CustomField entity, assigns a unique field number if necessary, and adds associated display field configurations.

methods.name: addCustomFieldToDisplayField
methods.description: Associates a CustomField with a display field and display field group, creating the display field if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getCustomFieldById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomField entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCustomFieldIds
methods.description: Checks for existing custom fields with specified IDs.

methods.name: deleteCustomFields
methods.description: Deletes custom fields and their associated display fields, handling the transaction process.

methods.name: deleteDisplayFieldsOfCustomFields
methods.description: Removes display fields associated with specified custom field IDs.

methods.name: searchCustomField
methods.description: Searches for custom fields based on filter parameters and returns matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object configured with filter parameters for paginated search.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of custom fields matching search filters.

methods.name: isCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Checks if a custom field is currently in use by any employee records.

methods.name: updateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Updates employee records by nullifying a custom field value if it matches a specified drop-down value.
